u0: Normal progress with no unresolved fall: keep or regain the box and navigate toward the exit, stepping onto it only while holding the box. Reaching the exit while holding it yields final success u3; reaching it empty-handed ends without RM reward. If the box falls, the machine enters u1 and requires an immediate recovery.
u1: The box has just fallen and is outside the agent's hands. The immediate objective is to pick it up on the very next step; the fall turns the agent to face the box, so the next action should be pickup. If the next step ends with the box held, the machine returns to u0 and awards 0.1; any other next-step outcome enters the unrecoverable failure state u2.
u2: Failure sink: the box fell and the immediate next-step pickup was missed, so the machine can never return to normal progress or reach final success. No further reward is available; all transitions remain in u2, and the Reward Machine objective is lost.
u3: Terminal success: the agent reached the exit while holding the box, earning the terminal reward of 1. The task is complete; no further Reward Machine action or reward is available.
